title: Migration is per-org transactional: a partial failure rolls back that org cleanly
preconds: Test tenant with at least 2 orgs. Inject a deliberate failure for one org (e.g., remove a target system role from the DB for that org's run).
steps:
1. Capture baseline role_v2_id for every user in both orgs.
2. Run the migration. Expect failure on the broken org.
3. Inspect the broken org: confirm no users were partially migrated (all role_v2_id still NULL or all preserved).
4. Inspect the healthy org: confirm migration completed for that org.
5. Inspect command exit code and stderr.
expected:
Step 3: Broken org has rolled back cleanly — no half-migrated state.
Step 4: Healthy org migrated successfully.
Step 5: Command exits non-zero with a clear error identifying the broken org.
